issues: React 'unique key' warning while rendering doc.responses right after add — new response lacks id until the PUT response is merged back into state. Not blocking. Fix: use a fallback key like r.id || `${doc.id}-${idx}` in DocumentManager response .map, OR ensure onChange consumers use the PUT response's normalized responses immediately (TaskDetail already does this via patch() -> setTask(data), so warning only flashes for one render).

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) DocumentManager.jsx line 129: change key={r.id} to key={r.id || `${doc.id}-r-${idx}`} to silence React key warning on the transient optimistic render.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/tasks.py compute() correctly falls back to legacy 'checklist' key for migrated tasks — good.
_norm_items always clears done_at when done=false — matches spec.

broadcast endpoint returns email_sent=True whenever requester.email exists regardless of SMTP send success — acceptable per spec ('best-effort'), but consider returning the actual send-attempt outcome so UI can display a warning when SMTP is unconfigured.
whatsapp_url uses wa.me (correct); browser opens api.whatsapp.com only because wa.me itself redirects — not a bug.
DocumentManager: label on Add-URL Dialog and Add-Response Dialog use idPrefix-scoped test ids which allow both task-level and item-level managers to coexist without selector collisions — good design.

TaskDetail patch(): reads full server response and merges attachments — avoids the stale-id class of bugs that affected MeetingDetail in iteration 1. Meetings should apply the same pattern (still open from previous iteration action item).
